# FG-DOC-0006

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_second_revision_of_a_document_is_refused_at_open` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この文書は別のマージリクエストで改訂中です。その改訂が終わるまで、新しい改訂のマージリクエストは作れません。
- en: This document is already being revised in another merge request. A new revision cannot be opened until that one is finished.
- id: Dokumen ini sedang direvisi di merge request lain. Revisi baru tidak dapat dibuka sampai revisi itu selesai.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 13 §7.5 / ADR-0027 §1 (stage 4 part A): one open revision per document. `POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests` was refused because the new merge request would change a document (a `.md` whose front matter names a `doctype`, by its `id`; a translation `<id>.<lang>.md` counts on its own) that an open merge request of the same project already revises. Which documents a merge request revises is derived from git — the `.md` files whose blob differs between the merge base with the target branch and the source branch's tip — and stored per merge request (`forge.merge_request_documents`) when it is opened and again by the `check.spec_index` job on each new version. Pushing is never refused (drafts are free); only opening a second revision is. Nothing was created. Every document is `single_revision` until the repository setting `single_revision` / `free` (ADR-0027 §2) is built; the refusal at merge time is plan 13 stage 4 part B.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event (`forge.web.request_failed`, warn) carries `doc_id`, `lang` (when a translation), `holder_iid` (the open merge request that revises it), `holder_since` and `project_id`. The document's open revisions: `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/documents/{doc_id}/status` or `gstn doc status <doc_id> --project <id>` (`revisions`). Read-only SQL: SELECT d.doc_id, d.lang, m.iid, m.state, d.since FROM forge.merge_request_documents d JOIN forge.merge_requests m ON m.id = d.merge_request_id WHERE d.project_id = <id> AND d.doc_id = '<doc_id>' ORDER BY d.since. When the listing of either side hit a bound (`forge.doc_revision.incomplete`, info) nothing is refused.

## 対処 (fix)

Comment or suggest on the open revision named by `holder_iid` instead, or wait until it is merged or closed. To revise two things at once, take the documents out of one of the branches, or merge the urgent one first (ADR-0027 §5).
